title: Across days since last PCP visit bucket
one_line_definition: This chart compares the volume of targeted care gaps distributed across patient segments defined by how many days have elapsed since their last primary care physician visit.
result_meaning: [{"movement": "Tallest bars concentrated in the longest days-since-visit buckets (e.g., 365+ days)", "signal": "Negative", "interpretation": "A high volume of targeted gaps among patients overdue for PCP visits indicates a disengaged population at elevated risk for unmanaged chronic conditions and poor risk capture."}, {"movement": "Tallest bars concentrated in the shortest days-since-visit buckets (e.g., 0\u201390 days)", "signal": "Positive", "interpretation": "Gaps clustering among recently seen patients suggest care teams have active touchpoints available to close those gaps quickly and improve HCC coding accuracy."}, {"movement": "Roughly equal bar heights across all days-since-visit buckets", "signal": "Investigate", "interpretation": "A uniform distribution of gaps across visit recency segments may signal systemic documentation or coding deficiencies that persist regardless of patient engagement frequency."}]
